repos_data.description: Terminal session manager for AI coding agents. One TUI for Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, Codex, and more.
A curated list of awesome tools, extensions, and resources for Gemini CLI.
Zero-configuration MCP server that unifies multiple AI coding assistants (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini) through intelligent auto-discovery and standardized interface
Local-first TUI for AI coding-agent session history: trace cost, tokens, time, tool failures, latency, health, diffs, reports, and CI gates across local agent logs.
A MCP server that enables you to manage Gitea/Forgejo repositories through AI assistants
MCP Server for DeepSeek API - enables MCP clients to use DeepSeek Chat and Reasoner models

papersflow-mcp is PapersFlow’s production MCP server for literature search, citation verification, related-paper discovery, and authenticated   research workflows across Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other MCP clients.
